cases.sentence: Он послал туда лошадей, колесницы и ___.
cases.explain: «большое войско» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Therefore he sent horses, chariots, and a great army there. They came by night, and surrounded the city.

cases.sentence: Когда рано утром слуга ___ поднялся и вышел, город был окружен войском с конями и колесницами.
cases.explain: «Божьего человека» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When the servant of the man of God had risen early, and gone out, behold, an army with horses and chariots was around the city. His servant said to him, “Alas, my master! What shall we do?”

cases.explain: «страшный голод» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: There was a great famine in Samaria. Behold, they besieged it, until a donkey’s head was sold for eighty pieces of silver, and the fourth part of a kab of dove’s dung for five pieces of silver.

cases.sentence: Когда царь Израиля проходил по ___, одна женщина закричала ему:
cases.explain: «городской стене» — after the preposition «по», the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: As the king of Israel was passing by on the wall, a woman cried to him, saying, “Help, my lord, O king!”

cases.sentence: На ___ я сказала ей: «Дай твоего сына — мы съедим его», но она спрятала его.
cases.explain: «другой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: So we boiled my son, and ate him: and I said to her on the next day, ‘Give your son, that we may eat him;’ and she has hidden her son.”
